title: Footnotes and endnotes docx 001
notes: real footnotes/endnotes support: word/footnotes.xml + word/endnotes.xml added with the ECMA-376 separator convention inside the parts (w:footnote/w:endnote ids -1 (w:separator) and 0 (w:continuationSeparator)) plus real notes ids 2..4; settings.xml w:footnotePr/w:endnotePr intentionally omitted (minimum viable per ECMA: separators live in the notes parts). [Content_Types].xml overrides and document.xml.rels footnotes/endnotes relationships added; body references via w:footnoteReference/w:endnoteReference runs wrapped onto anchor runs via zip_read/zip_write. LibreOffice renders footnote and endnote text into the PDF text layer, so the note strings are part of the reference text.
